title: KATSEYE’s Sophia Laforteza Is ‘Literally Doing Everything to Get Mentally Well,’ Her Mom Says
summary: Sophia stepped back for a break months after Manon Bannerman went on hiatus.
body: Sophia Laforteza’s mom, actress Carla Guevara-Laforteza, has shared a glimpse into how the KATSEYE leader is spending her time away from the group, sharing that the singer is taking some much-needed time for herself. Related KATSEYE React to ‘WILD’ News About First No. 1 Album on Billboard 200: ‘This Is So Surreal!!” KATSEYE Achieves First No. 1 Album on Billboard 200 With ‘WILD’ Cardi B Is Team KATSEYE, Clapping Back at ‘Hootie Frutti’ Haters The KATSEYE leader’s mother, theater actress Carla Guevara-Laforteza, opened up about her daughter’s current hiatus in an interview with Vogue Philippines published Monday (Aug. 24), explaining that Sophia is keeping busy with some decidedly more restrained activities as she prioritizes her well-being. “At present, Sophia is on hiatus,” Guevara-Laforteza said. “She goes to Disneyland every day; she’s baking, she’s painting. She’s literally doing everything to get mentally well.” Sophia’s break from KATSEYE was announced by HYBE x Geffen on Aug. 7, with the label confirming that she would temporarily step away from promotional activ…
